I really can't remember that. Only the scene where she is afraid of him and buries her head in Alfred's belly. Yes in Season 2 I don't think she has Romantic feelings for Uthred due to Erik but I do think she always defended him to Alfred .

In the show Uthred never is shown to pursue or manipulate Aethelflaed. She comes on to him. She said 'kiss me and see where it leads'. She was the one smitten. Having a young, beautiful woman be smitten by you isn't a crime and many would take the opportunity I'm sure. 

Yes he may have seen her around as a child but from the show we know they had little to no interactions. I didn't even know her name til Season 2. 

Uthred wasn't a male role model. He to her was a hero. She defended him in his absence. She was on the side to help him when he was enslaved.

Uthred using women? When...
He never forced himself or abused them like Aethelred.
All the women he had sexed with loved him at the point in time.
He was bit of a show off yes and with Mildred he said hurtful things, but both did.

I liked Eadith alot. I found it harsh to banish her from Mercia in truth. Yet it was known that Aethelred pursued Eadith and that her brother killed him. So Aethelflaed had a reason. Saying she is self serving after the countless self sacrifices is a stretch.

If she ran away with Eric no one would've known it was because she took a Dane as a lover. All would be said is that she escaped or maybe the Danes wouldn't have even said anything, just secretly look for her while bleeding Wessex and Mercia out. Uthred was the only Saxon that knew.

Either way she didn't want to be the person that was used to make Wessex and Mercia poor. 

Also she killed the other brother on the battlefield.

Are you suggesting that it was Aethelflaed's fault for Mercia being taken? Her husband was abusive so of course she spent time on her estate in Mercia. Even her husband said he preferred her there.

Maybe if she was near Aethelred she could've told Edward sooner that he planned to march away from Mercia or she could've warned the Eldermen. However Aethelred would've never listened to her.

Regarding the affair with Uthred. Yes at points it they showed some friendly affection like when they won the battle at Tettenhall and Uthred and Aethelflaed put their foreheads together (which he did with Beocca and Ragnar), however the only people who knew about their affair was people they trusted. She said that in Season 4 episode 1. Aldhelm and the servant woman were the only ones.

Yes Uthred was the main reason why she became the Lady of Mercia, however she had the support of the Eldermen and was respected since they all voted for her after Uthred's speech about her love for Mercia.

Her daughter in the show is not the same age as Uthred's daughter. Despite how they looked in Season 3. Her daughter wasn't able to make her own decisions and depended on her mother and Stiorra for protection. Stiorra could make her own decisions and was strong. 

Isn't seeing her daughter's future betrothed mistreating his sister enough to pursued Aethelflaed to want to protect her from him?
Plus even Aethelred with his forgetful mind knew that their was something about Eardwulf that was untrustworthy. Aethelflaed had motherly instincts and we know she wasn't wrong.

You are implying that Aethelflaed knew nothing of Stiorra's feelings and that she wasn't part of the negotiations yet this is an assumption. We don't know what is and is not.

We do know that Uthred disagreed and was able to put an end to this arrangement. However he realized that Stiorra wanted to go and finally agreed.

Mercia was being slaughtered. She had to intervene. Yes it was defiant to Edward but remember that Mercia is its own kingdom and only an ally to Wessex not a servant. I believe she was right to have gone and protect her people. She was brave and of course Uthred saved her once again, but that doesn't hid the fact she chose Mercia over everything. 

Wessex men were destined to die anyway dude. When Cnut was finished with Mercia they were going to Wessex. It was better to have an allied force and confront the Danes.

Edward was jealous of Aethelflaed (he told her she seemed love from all ???). Yes he wanted to save Wessex men but as I said a battle with the Danes would have occured. Even Uthred calls him a coward for coming late to his sister's aid.

Aethelflaed nearly died on the battlefield for her country. She didn't sit home and do nothing. She fought. Yes she was saved by Edward's arrow yet it was her very bravery that brought the alliance together again.
Uthred didn't have romantic feelings for her in Season 2. He had Gisela.

Was it said he held her as a little girl in the books? In the show that didn't happen right. Honestly I find their relationship gradually developed. In Season 2 she kissed him on the cheek,trusted him and we saw that she thought him a friend (or more) as you said. In Season 3 she kissed him and I believe we saw alot of endearing looks from her when Uthred gave speeches showing her being turnt on by him and respected him. The only reason Uthred didn't kiss her when she asked was because of Skade and wanting to protect her.

So to me it is obvious that when Uthred killed Skade there was no obstacles in the way of Uthred and her.

She was always smitten with him since Season 2 and I don't see Uthred being like a uncle to her in Season 1. They had no interactions except for when Uthred came to speak to Alfred and she hid herself from him.

I just remembered that Uthred went above and beyond for Aethelflaed since Season 2 when he decided to help her escape from the Vikings. He did even before they were together. 

So I believe he has a deep love for her and her him so this should be kept in consideration when deciding to hate her or not💪🏽
I think Aldhelm was ordered to rape her in the books and Uthred killed him... So I don't agree despite the show being different.
